resources.title: Project Structure & Naming Conventions Reference
resources.description: The real folder structure and naming rules from Chapters 2-3 (staging/intermediate/marts, `stg_`/`int_`/`fct_`/`dim_` prefixes, one staging model per source table, the three-layer philosophy) as a one-page reference — the same decisions a new dbt project has to make on day one, made once here so you don't re-derive them per project.

resources.title: Incremental Strategy & Materialization Decision Guide
resources.description: A decision table covering every materialization (view, table, incremental, ephemeral) and every incremental strategy (merge, delete+insert, append) from Chapters 2 and 5, with the specific situation each one is correct for — plus the two gotchas from Lesson 27 (schema drift, late-arriving data) and when `--full-refresh` is the right call versus an expensive habit.

resources.title: Testing Decision Guide: What to Test Where
resources.description: A practical guide to Chapter 4's testing toolkit — when a generic test (`unique`, `not_null`, `relationships`, `accepted_values`) is enough versus when a situation needs a singular test encoding a real business rule, plus a checklist of the columns that almost always deserve a test (primary keys, foreign keys, anything a report sums or joins on) so test coverage isn't just "add tests everywhere."

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing your finished capstone — or any dbt project — against a real professional standard. Shared across the Analytics Engineer path's courses.
